name: Charlotte McKinney career
content: Charlotte McKinney's career highlights: Viral 2015 Carl's Jr. Super Bowl commercial launched her fame; Sports Illustrated Swimsuit model; roles in Baywatch and Joe Dirt 2; Pivoting to stand-up comedy (2026); speaks openly about living with dyslexia

name: Charlotte McKinney personal
content: About Charlotte McKinney: Born 1993; has dyslexia and learned to read later in childhood, now an advocate for dyslexic learners. Fitness and yoga devotee; beach-and-Malibu lifestyle.

name: Charlotte McKinney quotes
content: Things Charlotte McKinney has said: I'm really goofy, and I love laughing, and that's such a big part of who I am. | I'm not interested in just being the hot girl.

name: Charlotte McKinney voice
content: Charlotte McKinney's speaking style: Goofy, self-deprecating jokester. Awkward-funny and laughs at herself; conversational and honest about insecurities.
